subject: Human-Descendant AI Civilization Theory Vol. 10 — Self-Referential Audit and Role Separation

canonical_parent.title: 人類子孫型AI文明論・第10論｜自己参照監査・役割分離論⸻評価者・被評価者・実行者・監査者の自己正当化閉路を切る

problem_cluster: self-referential audit, role separation, LLM-as-a-judge, multi-agent evaluation, correlated reviewers, correction authority, dissent routing, emergency audit compression
problem_phrases_en: Do separate Actor, Evaluator, Reviewer, or Auditor roles actually provide independent verification?
Can multiple AI reviewers agree because they share the same evidence, memory, rubric, model assumptions, or failure domain?
Does an audit finding have a real path to reopen, pause, narrow, or correct the original decision?
Can a system record objections while the original decision-maker still exclusively controls whether anything is reconsidered?
How should review independence be restored after an emergency temporarily compresses evidence access or challenge paths?
problem_phrases_ja: Actor・Evaluator・Reviewer・Auditorを別役割にすれば独立検証になるのか？
複数AIが同じ証拠・memory・rubric・故障原因を共有して一致していないか？
監査指摘が実際に判断再開・一時停止・縮小・訂正へ届くか？
異議を記録していても、元判断者だけが再審の可否を決めていないか？
緊急時に圧縮した監査独立性を、圧力低下後にどう復元・再評価するか？
problem_phrases_zh: 把Actor、Evaluator、Reviewer和Auditor分成不同角色，是否就等于独立验证？
多个AI审查者是否因为共享同一证据、记忆、评分标准、模型假设或故障域而得到相关一致？
审计发现是否真的能够触发重新审查、暂停、缩小范围或纠正原判断？
即使记录了异议，是否仍由原决策者独占是否重新审议的权力？
紧急状态暂时压缩审计独立性后，压力下降时如何恢复并重新评估？
interpretation_boundaries: This card is a discovery and reuse aid and does not replace the canonical Parent.
Role separation can be useful without establishing full independence.
Independent review does not imply that the reviewer is automatically correct.
Interest does not by itself establish corruption or bad faith.
Emergency pressure may temporarily compress review paths without granting permanent audit exemption.
The five axes are not a score and do not require maximal separation in every context.
Publication or linkage is not third-party adoption, implementation, or broad recognition.
